changeRecord.title: moment release added
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A released end cannot transmit bending moment. The moment the connection carried has to go somewhere else: span moments grow, the joint and the members framing into it lose that moment, and a frame that resisted sway through that connection becomes more flexible.
changeRecord.precondition: a frame member end whose bending rotations are rigidly connected
